description: x-exposed false keeps a column, or a whole table, out of every view

statements:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `internal` (
  `id` blob PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (uuid7()) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
  `owner` blob,
  `value` text,
  CONSTRAINT `internal_owner_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`owner`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `internal_owner_index` ON `internal` (`owner`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `secret` (
  `id` blob PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (uuid7()) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
  `owner` blob,
  `visibility` text DEFAULT 'private' NOT NULL,
  `value` text,
  `internal` text,
  CONSTRAINT `secret_owner_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`owner`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `secret_visibility_check` CHECK(`visibility` IN ('private', 'authenticated', 'public'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `secret_owner_index` ON `secret` (`owner`)

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `internal_updated`
AFTER UPDATE ON `internal`
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
    UPDATE `internal`
    SET updated_at = CAST(
      (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER
    )
    WHERE id = OLD.id;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `secret_updated`
AFTER UPDATE ON `secret`
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
    UPDATE `secret`
    SET updated_at = CAST(
      (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER
    )
    WHERE id = OLD.id;
END;

CREATE VIEW `secret_view` AS
SELECT
  `t`.`id` AS `_key`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `t`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `t`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `t`.`value` AS `value`
FROM `secret` AS `t`
